headline: Sales dip on divestiture, cost discipline lifts profit
summary_short: Sonoco's Q2 FY2026 net sales fell 1.3% y/y to $1,885M as the ThermoSafe divestiture and softer volumes outweighed pricing and FX gains, while GAAP operating profit rose 9.8% y/y to $192.8M on productivity savings and lower one-time costs.
summary_long: Net sales fell 1.3% y/y to $1.9B: the ThermoSafe divestiture (-$65.7M) and weaker volumes (-$22.9M) outweighed pricing (+$37.0M) and FX (+$29.3M) gains. GAAP operating profit rose 9.8% to $192.8M on productivity/procurement savings and lower restructuring and deal costs, partly offset by unfavorable price/cost. Gross margin slipped to 20.8% from 21.3%. GAAP EPS fell to $1.05 from $4.96 y/y, entirely reflecting the $424.5M TFP divestiture gain booked a year ago; Adjusted diluted EPS rose to $1.51 from $1.37. H1 operating cash flow was -$67.3M (vs -$14.7M), capex $125.8M; quarter-end cash fell to $168.6M from $378.4M at YE2025 on tax payments tied to 2025 divestiture gains and debt paydown. No FY2026 guidance change stated.
